resources.string: Version %1$s is available. Download the update? Android will require installation confirmation.
The update could not be verified or downloaded. Your current version continues to work.
Allow updates from DroidBridge in system settings. After returning, Android will ask you to confirm installation.
Update installed. Tap to open DroidBridge.
Wake with Wake-on-LAN, shut down or restart over your network. Your phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
Use the same key as on your PC
PC not responding. It may be off or the listener has stopped.
Enter the IP address and key to see PC status.
Opening the client window on PC…
Screen capture permission is required to cast.
Enter your PC access key first.
Enter your PC IP address first.
Starting cast. See the notification for connection status.
View only for now. To control the phone, tap “Allow phone control from PC” and enable the service manually.
PC did not open the cast. Check the connection and key; stop casting and try again.
Phone screen and audio are being sent to PC
Enter the IP address and key in settings.
PC not responding. Check Wi-Fi and the listener.
Long-press an app tile to close it on PC.
Close %1$s on PC. Unsaved data may be lost.
Closing is not configured for this app.
Send a magic packet to port 9 (Wake-on-LAN)
Request a normal shutdown with a 20-second cancellation window
Ready. Make sure your phone and PC are on the same network.
Invalid MAC address: enter 12 hexadecimal digits
Enter the access key to send commands to PC

This accessibility service lets your trusted PC tap, swipe, open Home and type into the selected editable field. It works only while casting the phone and after verifying the PC key. It does not use the clipboard or bypass password fields or protected screens. Enable “Control phone from PC” manually in system settings. Gestures require Android 7 or later. Restart casting after enabling the service or rotating the screen. You can revoke permission here at any time.
PC found on the local network; IP and Wake-on-LAN updated
Enter the PC IP address and key in connection settings
No file picker app is available on this phone
Away: locking PC and turning the display off…
Enter the network broadcast address or wait for discovery while the PC is on
Error: PC IP address is missing
Shutdown requested: you have 20 seconds to cancel.
Restart requested: you have 20 seconds to cancel.
Tap to click; hold to right-click; move to drag
Enable control while the stream is live first
Wait for previous commands to finish
Transfer cancelled. If the PC already received the file, it remains in Downloads
File size changed. Select it again
Could not read the complete file
Could not open the selected file
Timer: shutdown in %1$d min. Use Cancel command to cancel.
Magic packets sent: %1$d. The PC should wake if Power On By PCI-E / Wake on LAN is enabled in BIOS.
PC returned HTTP %1$d. The listener may need an update
%1$s\nTo Downloads on PC\nKeep the app open until complete
Cannot resolve IP address: %1$s. Check the PC IP address field.
Port %1$d is unavailable (%2$s). The listener may have stopped or the port is blocked. Run start-listener.ps1 or run-foreground.bat on PC.
PC silent: %1$s:%2$d did not respond within 4 s. It may be off or asleep — use Wake up. If it is on, check the listener and shared Wi-Fi network.
Connected but no response arrived (%1$s). Shutdown or restart MAY have started — use Cancel command.
Connected but no response arrived (%1$s). Check the PC log: the command may have run.
No connection: %1$s. Check the PC listener and open port.

On the PC open DroidBridge → Connect phone. Paste the link or open it with a camera that supports these links. Compare the code on both devices and approve on the PC. Start again after rotating or closing this screen.
Only connect to your own PC on a trusted local network. After approval the new pairing replaces the current one.
Invalid pairing link. Get a new link on the PC.
Pairing was cancelled. Get a new link on the PC and start again.
Code: %1$s\nCompare this code with the PC window and approve there.
Save this PC? The current pairing will be replaced.
Pairing did not complete. Check the network and PC approval, then get a new link. The current pairing was not changed.
No programs yet. On the PC open DroidBridge → Programs and add programs.
Connect to the PC to load programs.
An unfinished transfer exists. Continue it or discard it before choosing a new file? Discard needs the original PC online; a file already saved there is not deleted.
The PC or key changed. Restore the original settings to continue or discard this transfer.
Not enough space for the temporary copy. Free space and continue, or discard the transfer.
The pending record is damaged or unavailable. A new transfer will not replace it automatically.
Could not save transfer state. Check available storage.
Transfer paused. Use the upload button to continue. No background upload is running.
Unfinished transfer, temporary copy and source access removed. Files already saved on the PC remain.
Checking the entire source before continuing… This may take time.
The source changed. Discard this transfer and select the file again.
The PC is checking and saving the entire file… You can pause.
Connection lost. Retrying after checking the received part…
Wait for the previous transfer to stop.
The file provider did not allow persistent access. Choose another source: reliable resume after restart requires it.

Discard transfer removes unfinished data on the original PC and phone. If the PC or original key is unavailable, choose Phone only: the PC part remains until its 7-day expiry. Already saved files are not deleted.
Phone state, temporary copy and source access removed. The PC part may remain for up to 7 days.
The PC no longer knows this transfer or did not confirm its creation. Restart is not automatic: the destination may have changed. Discard the transfer and explicitly select the file again.
